description: Search the evidence linking genes to diseases, from Open Targets: the open drug target discovery platform built by EMBL-EBI, the Wellcome Sanger Institute and a group of pharmaceutical companies. Ask which genes are worth going after for a disease, or what a gene has already been linked to, and get a score from 0 to 1 that pools human genetics, known drugs, animal models, pathways, expression and the literature, with the working shown. Look up targets, diseases, drugs, variants and GWAS studies; read what a drug treats and what side effects it has; see where a gene is expressed and what it interacts with; and find the papers behind any of it. Names work everywhere identifiers do, so 'TP53' and 'asthma' are enough. No account or API key required.
